title: Shun Ueki (PLANT): modular type built on visible grids and type-metric lines
note: Grid and paper design inspo. Shun Ueki (PLANT, Tokyo visual design studio; runs the 'over-decorated letter design club' type-edfc.club) posted four 10 s vertical clips on 2026-11-27 (JST). Letters are built from ellipses, half-circles and bow-tie triangles snapped to a visible grid, with ASC / CAP / X / BASE / DESC guide lines, tiny parameter readouts (SLANT, MIN, MAX, GRID, FILL) and tick rulers; the glyphs slant and morph between settings. Four palettes: cream with red and blue, yellow with red and navy, dark green with pink, lavender with violet. Thumbnails are frames from the videos.
